traps_new: 111. `git commit --only` treats later flags as pathspecs after `--`; put `-m` before `--`.

112. Stale-cache guard (trap 94 family): every module whose source changed must be selected in EVERY job until its cache entry refreshes. A failed build keeps its old cache entry, so the failing module must be selected (last) even in diagnostic jobs.

113. The C type-pun `*(int32_t*)&tt` has cast target `int32_t *`: the `*` is a token between the type and `)`. A shorter pattern silently fails (fresh falls through, parse none). Print the raw token list before designing patterns.

114. `#define`/`#undef` macro scope cannot live in a shared lexer (no `#` token); token substitution with a threaded macro table is C's textual semantics. The nested tokenizer recursion for the macro body must reuse the outer structural fuel or termination checking fails.

115. Unused lambda binders in `#eval` callbacks trigger unusedVariables under warningAsError, and unqualified sibling-namespace names do not resolve in probe scope: use `_` binders and full qualification even in diagnostic modules.
